cases.name: Tina Michelle Thomas
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "Tina was a great mother who loved her son Jameke Thomas dearly. She was the best big sister who supported her younger sisters in everything. She was dependable, loving and caring. She treated her nieces and nephews as if they were her own.

Tina was a 1990 graduate of Marlboro County High School. After high school she entered the workforce. She has been employed at Mohawk for a numerous of years. She was a member of St. Peter AME Zion Church of Clio, SC."
